in_sanskrit.name: यदुवांशी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Person belonging to the Yadava clan. Yadu is a name of Krishna himself. The Yadavas are an ancient tribe mentioned in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Yaduvanshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे descendant of Yadu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yaduvanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is a descendant of the legendary king Yadu, who is also known as the Yadavas or the Vanshis.

in_bengali.name: Yaduvanshi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ descendant of Yadu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yaduvanshi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is a descendant of the legendary king Yadu, who is also known as the Yadavas or the Vanshis.
